assessment: The empty ScienceCard omits a directly executable minimum-mass-ratio relation for the preferred two-satellite fit. The source reports a 37-Jupiter-mass host at line 210, central projected satellite masses M sin(i) = 0.743 and 0.277 Jupiter masses at lines 282 and 290, and the corresponding approximate minimum mass ratios of 2 percent and 0.7 percent at line 245. These quantities support q_min(%) = 100(M sin(i))/37 on the discrete control domain {0.277, 0.743}, strictly as projected minimum mass ratios because inclination and true masses are unconstrained at line 247. A revised card can encode this closed relation.

issues.detail: The card omits q_min(%) = 100(M sin(i))/37 for the two reported central projected masses {0.277, 0.743} Jupiter masses; it must preserve the minimum-mass interpretation because true masses are not constrained.
